lc_person: Andrew Schumann, logic scholar and head of cognitive science at the University of Information Technology and Management in Rzeszow; author of Philosophical Logic and Archaeology of Logic.
item_person: Andrew Schumann, visual artist, born 1938 according to Wikidata; the item also carries authority identifiers for the logic scholar.

evidence.says: Authority Schumann, Andrew cites Philosophical logic (2008) and Archaeology of logic (2023). The latter identifies the head of cognitive science at the University of Information Technology and Management in Rzeszow; its ECIP information supplies birth year 1983. LC also links Q98761175, VIAF 165494426 and ISNI 0000000117878176.

The university identifies Andrew Schumann as head of cognitive science and mathematical modelling, with research in logic, artificial intelligence, computer science and history of philosophy. It links ORCID 0000-0002-9944-8627 and lists Swarm Intelligence: From Social Bacteria to Humans (2020), also cited in LC's authority notes.

The item is labelled Andrew Schumann and described as a visual artist. It states birth year 1938 and cites artist identifiers P4663 and P3901 for that year. It also includes P244 no2009020996, VIAF 165494426 and ISNI 0000000117878176, mixing the artist profile with the scholar's authority identifiers; no ORCID is stated.

The artist's own biography describes an art-history degree at Cambridge, subsequent work in industry, a full-time art practice from a studio in King's Lynn, and exhibitions at the Royal Academy Summer Exhibition. This is a distinct professional biography from the university's logic scholar.

notes: Apparent Wikidata conflation, rather than a birth-year typo establishing a single identity. LC fits the graph through the exact ORCID and matching affiliation and work. Birth year left unresolved for the LC scholar: 1983 is an LC ECIP statement, not independently verified here. No separate QID for the scholar was verified. LC and Wikidata were inspected through their structured exports after ordinary page access failed.
